summary: RETEST Phase 2.4B after iteration_9 fixes — ALL green. 24/24 backend pytest pass (1 skipped by design). The 3 previously failing tests (test_invoices_endpoint_returns_payment_with_url, test_invoice_url_returns_pdf, test_email_log_exists_after_webhook) now PASS. Manual curl confirms GET /api/invoices returns non-empty list with valid invoice_url; GET invoice_url returns 200 application/pdf 2670 bytes (%PDF-1.4). POST /api/coupons with value=150 kind=percent returns 422 (validator). POST with value=-5 also 422 (Field(ge=0)). Frontend route guard for /super-admin verified for admin, bella, ana (all redirected to /dashboard) and super_admin retains access. Admin's /minha-assinatura shows both invoice-download-<id> links with valid PDF hrefs.

minor.issue: Still no admin/super_admin endpoint to inspect db.email_logs. Recommendation carried over from iteration_9 for observability; not blocking.
GET /api/coupons/validate/{code} still returns OK for any plan when applies_to=[] — documented behaviour, not a bug, but worth documenting explicitly in the OpenAPI schema.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix DialogContent still warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' (a11y). Not blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Add DialogDescription to coupon-form-dialog for a11y (silences Radix warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3606 — locale-swap now correctly applied only to `amount_br` (pre-formatted number), not the whole HTML template. Same fix applied to send_email_payment_confirmed (line 3568). Root cause resolved cleanly.
CouponIn (server.py:3323) — Field(ge=0) prevents negative values, and field_validator enforces value<=100 when kind='percent'. Both server-side checks return proper 422 responses.
App.js:82 — <Route path='super-admin'> now correctly wrapped in <ProtectedRoute roles={['super_admin']}>. Route guard verified for 4 roles via browser automation.
server.py file size is still ~3737 lines; recommendation from iteration_8/9 to split into routers/services still stands. Not a 2.4B blocker.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 route guard scenarios pass, invoice-download links render correctly on /minha-assinatura)
